facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 59°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 4 to 24 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 30; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), July 8 (2024), July 4 (2025)

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: left May 14; earlier seasons: June 5 (2023), June 7 (2024), June 5 (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 17; earlier seasons: June 12 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and the lowest at Beaver Pass (3,630 ft) and Marten Ridge (3,520 ft).

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: 95.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 89.3 in (2023), 71.0 in (2024), 87.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: 15.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 34.1 in (2023), 27.0 in (2024), 31.2 in (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: 23.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 59.8 in (2023), 32.0 in (2024), 46.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 2 and June 23, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 30, 1,149 ft above the pass; points to May 11 to July 10

evidence.name: Beaver Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 14, 501 ft below the pass; points to April 28 to June 17

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 17, 611 ft below the pass; points to May 2 to June 23
